name: dsh-easytier
description: EasyTier network manager for the dsh web GUI: auto-discovers the EasyTier instance running on this machine by process and RPC portal, lists every terminal in the current network, manages them through EasyTier's own port forwarding, whitelist, temporary credentials, connector, route and service features, and shows/edits the instance config file with validation and automatic backup. When EasyTier is not installed it offers a one-click initialization that downloads the latest stable release from GitHub and unpacks it into the user directory, with a live log and progress; the download can run through a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy given as ip:port, and an existing EasyTier directory can be adopted after its binaries are checked, and the panel can start a relay-only node itself. Ships a sidebar panel plus an agent tool (easytier). Zero runtime dependencies.
